ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) across approximately 90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) clusters concentrated at the distal tips and along the waterline interface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation across both primary lobes; focal high-contrast white geometric clusters located at the terminal left and right tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute interior angle and a narrow, well-defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations forming a jagged sequence of peaks and valleys across the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve originating from the peduncle, tapering to sharp upward-pointing tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, high-contrast circular white pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal ends of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, high-contrast linear disruption (white) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white scarring on the left lobe mid-section and heavy calcified deposits/barnacle scarring at the lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-intensity white speckling across the lower fluke surface caused by high-contrast water spray/droplets.
